attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post of 2024-06-21, stated in his own voice. He cites Murati as his reason, but the forecast is his.

semantics.note: 'More confident than ever that GPT-5 won't land' expresses confidence in a definite outcome, so it is a scored forecast. 'This year' means calendar 2024. Reading 'land' as a release is faithful.

contract.note: Reading 'land' as a public release of a model OpenAI calls GPT-5 is the natural sense. No plausible alternative reading changes the result, since GPT-5 first appeared in August 2025.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own release page, dated 2025-08-07 and available before the evaluation date, introduces GPT-5 as new. It is a company disclosure, but it is the release itself, and it implies no GPT-5 release in 2024.

output.rationale: The forecast window ended 2024-12-31 and has elapsed. OpenAI's announcement introduced GPT-5 on 2025-08-07, after the window. The packet lists no counterevidence of any 2024 release of a model called GPT-5, so the support condition is met.
